text.p: - These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Laurent Kabila, the president of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, arrived yesterday in Luanda for two days of talks with Angolan officials.

- A high level delegation of Angolan officials, including presidential advisor Victor Lima and vice-minister for Territorial Administration, Higino Carneiro met yesterday with State Department officials in Washington.
